parts.q: Timur is ______ his brother Bobur.
parts.explain: Gapda ikkita shaxs solishtirilyapti va «than» so‘zi bor, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja: taller than.

parts.q: This is ______ film I have ever seen.
parts.explain: Gapda «ever seen» orqali eng oliy daraja so‘ralmoqda, shuning uchun: the most interesting.

parts.q: Gulnara is ______ girl in our class.
parts.explain: Sinfdoshlar orasida eng aqllisi nazarda tutilyapti, shuning uchun orttirma daraja: the smartest.

parts.q: My bag is ______ your bag.
parts.explain: Ikki sumka solishtirilyapti, «than» so‘zi bor, shuning uchun: heavier than.

parts.q: Today is ______ day of the year.
parts.explain: Yilning eng issiq kuni haqida gap ketmoqda, shuning uchun orttirma daraja: the hottest.

parts.q: Aziz runs ______ Rustam.
parts.explain: Ikki kishining tezligi solishtirilyapti, «than» ishlatilgan, shuning uchun: faster than.

parts.q: Mount Everest is ______ mountain in the world.
parts.explain: Dunyo bo‘yicha eng baland tog‘ nazarda tutilyapti, shuning uchun: the highest.

parts.q: English is ______ math for me.
parts.explain: Fanlar o‘zaro solishtirilyapti va «than» bor, shuning uchun: easier than.

parts.q: This exercise is ______ than the previous one.
parts.explain: Qiyosiy daraja «much» bilan kuchaytirilmoqda, shuning uchun: much harder.

parts.q: She is ______ student in the school.
parts.explain: Maktabdagi eng yaxshi o‘quvchi, «good» so‘zining orttirma darajasi: the best.

parts.q: Winter is ______ season in Tashkent.
parts.explain: Toshkentdagi eng sovuq fasl haqida gap ketyapti, shuning uchun: the coldest.

parts.q: He is ______ player in the team.
parts.explain: Jamoadagi eng yomon o‘yinchi, «bad» so‘zining orttirma darajasi: the worst.

parts.q: This room is ______ small for five people.
parts.explain: Yetarli emaslik yoki me’yordan ortiqlik «too» orqali bildiriladi: too small.

parts.q: Is this tea warm ______ for you?
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin kelib yetarlilikni bildiruvchi so‘z: enough.

parts.q: We don't have ______ money to buy a car.
parts.explain: Ism oldidan kelib yetarlilikni bildiruvchi so‘z: enough money.

parts.q: The soup is ______ hot to eat right now.
parts.explain: Juda issiqligidan yeb bo‘lmasligini ko‘rsatadi: too hot.

parts.q: She has ______ experience for this job.
parts.explain: Ism oldidan «yetarli» ma’nosini beruvchi so‘z: enough experience.

parts.q: He is not tall ______ to play basketball.
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin yetarlilikni bildiradi: tall enough.

parts.q: It is ______ noisy in this street.
parts.explain: Me’yordan ortiq shovqinli ekanini bildiradi: too noisy.

parts.q: Do we have ______ chairs for everyone?
parts.explain: O‘rinlar yetarliligini so‘rash uchun ism oldidan «enough» keladi.

parts.q: The box is ______ heavy for me to lift.
parts.explain: Ko‘tarib bo‘lmas darajada og‘irligini bildiradi: too heavy.

parts.q: She didn't sleep ______ hours last night.
parts.explain: Soatlar soni yetmaganini bildirish uchun ism oldidan: enough hours.

parts.q: This dress is ______ expensive for my budget.
parts.explain: Budjet uchun me’yordan qimmatligini bildiradi: too expensive.

parts.q: Are you warm ______ in that light jacket?
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin yetarlilikni bildiruvchi so‘z: warm enough.

parts.q: There are ______ people in the shop today.
parts.explain: Sanoqli ismlar bilan me’yordan ko‘pligini bildirish uchun: too many.

parts.q: He drinks ______ coffee every morning.
parts.explain: Sanab bo‘lmaydigan ism bilan me’yordan ko‘pligini bildirish uchun: too much.

parts.q: That test was ______ difficult for the students.
parts.explain: O‘quvchilar uchun o‘ta qiyin bo‘lganini bildiradi: too difficult.

parts.q: Do you have ______ time to finish the project?
parts.explain: Vaqt yetarliligini so‘rash uchun ism oldidan: enough time.

parts.q: The music is ______ loud, please turn it down.
parts.explain: Me’yordan balandligini bildiradi: too loud.

parts.q: We have ______ food for the party.
parts.explain: Ovqat yetarliligini bildiradi: enough food.

parts.q: He drives ______ dangerously on the highway.
parts.explain: Ravish oldidan me’yordan ortiqligini bildiradi: too dangerously.

parts.q: Is the water warm ______ to swim?
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin kelib yetarlilikni bildiradi: warm enough.

parts.q: She bought ______ shoes yesterday.
parts.explain: Sanoqli ism oldidan ko‘plikni bildiradi: too many shoes.

parts.q: There is ______ salt in this soup.
parts.explain: Sanab bo‘lmaydigan ism oldidan ortiqlikni bildiradi: too much salt.

parts.q: He is ______ tired to go out tonight.
parts.explain: Charchagani uchun chiqolmasligini bildiradi: too tired.

parts.q: I don't have ______ patience for this game.
parts.explain: Ism oldidan yetarlilikni bildiradi: enough patience.

parts.q: This house is ______ big for just two people.
parts.explain: Odamlar soniga nisbatan o‘ta kattaligini bildiradi: too big.

parts.q: Samarkand is ______ Bukhara for tourists.
parts.explain: Gapda solishtiruv bor va «than» so‘zi ishlatilgan. Shuning uchun comparative shakli: older than.

parts.q: Our school library has ______ books than the local one.
parts.explain: Ko'plikdagi otlar bilan comparative yasash uchun «more» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Malika speaks English ______ her sister.
parts.explain: «Good» sifatining qiyosiy darajasi «better» bo‘lib, «than» bilan birga keladi.

parts.q: My new laptop is ______ than my old one.
parts.explain: Gapda «than» bor va solishtirilyapti, shuning uchun comparative sifat: faster.

parts.q: That green car is ______ expensive than the red one.
parts.explain: Gapda «than» bor va sifat ikki bo‘g‘inli, shuning uchun comparative: more expensive.

wrong.much: Bu yerda darajani kuchaytirish uchun emas, qiyoslash uchun «more» kerak.
wrong.too: «Too» sifatdan oldin keladi va «haddan tashqari» ma’nosini beradi.

parts.q: Registan Square is ______ place in Samarkand.
parts.explain: Gapda «in Samarkand» va «the» bor, shuning uchun orttirma daraja: the most famous.

wrong.more famous: Bu ikki narsani solishtirish uchun ishlatiladi.

parts.q: Feruza is ______ student in our school club.
parts.explain: Gapda «in our school club» bor, shuning uchun noto‘g‘ri sifatning orttirma darajasi: the best.

wrong.best: Orttirma daraja oldidan «the» artikli bo‘lishi shart.

parts.q: This physics test was ______ difficult for me to pass.
parts.explain: Gap oxirida «to pass» fe’li bor, shuning uchun «too» ishlatiladi: too difficult.

parts.q: Can you open the window? It is ______ hot in here.
parts.explain: Salbiy ma’no va darajaning ortiqligini ko‘rsatish uchun «too» kerak: too hot.

wrong.much: Bu yerda yolg‘iz o‘zi mos kelmaydi.

parts.q: I have ______ time to finish my homework before dinner.
parts.explain: Ot (time) dan oldin kelib yetarlilikni bildiradi: enough time.

wrong.too much: Gap ijobiy ma’noda va yetarli vaqt borligini bildiradi.

parts.q: Are you warm ______ in that thin jacket?
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin kelib yetarlilikni bildiradi: warm enough.

parts.q: There are ______ cars on the Tashkent roads during rush hour.
parts.explain: Sanaladigan ko‘plikdagi ot (cars) bilan ortiqchalikni bildirish uchun: too many.

parts.q: He spends ______ money on video games every month.
parts.explain: Sanalmaydigan ot (money) bilan ortiqchalikni bildirish uchun: too much.

wrong.enough: Gapda pulni ko‘p sarflash haqida shikoyat bor.

parts.q: My sister draws ______ than I do.
parts.explain: Gapda «than» bor va «well» ravishining qiyosiy darajasi kerak: better.

parts.q: This is ______ interesting book I have ever read.
parts.explain: Gapda «ever read» va «in» ma’nosi bor, orttirma daraja: the most interesting.

parts.q: Javohir is not old ______ to drive a car in Uzbekistan.
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin kelib yetarli yoshda emasligini bildiradi: old enough.

parts.q: The tea is ______ cold to drink right now.
parts.explain: Sifatdan oldin kelib haddan tashqari salqinligini bildiradi: too cold.

parts.q: We don't have ______ chairs for all the guests.
parts.explain: Sanaladigan ot (chairs) oldidan yetarlilikni bildiradi: enough chairs.

parts.q: My father's car is ______ than my uncle's car.
parts.explain: Gapda «than» bor va «big» so‘zi ikkita harfni ikkilantiradi: bigger.

parts.q: Chemistry is ______ difficult than history for me.
parts.explain: Qiyosiy darajani (difficult) kuchaytirish uchun «much» ishlatiladi: much more difficult.

parts.q: She speaks Japanese ______ than anyone else in class.
parts.explain: «Well» ravishining qiyosiy darajasi «than» bilan ishlatiladi: better.

parts.q: This suitcase is ______ heavy for me to carry alone.
parts.explain: Fe’ldan oldin kelib imkonsizligini bildiradi: too heavy.

parts.q: Do we have ______ information about the trip to Khiva?
parts.explain: Sanalmaydigan ot (information) oldidan yetarlilikni bildiradi: enough information.

parts.q: My little brother is ______ tall to ride this roller coaster.
parts.explain: Sifatdan oldin kelib taqiqni bildiradi: too tall.

parts.q: Are there ______ students in the library today?
parts.explain: Sanaladigan ko‘plikdagi ot oldidan so‘roq gapda ishlatiladi: enough students.

parts.q: This exercise is ______ easy for our grade level.
parts.explain: Me’yordan ortiqligini bildirish uchun sifat oldidan «too» keladi: too easy.

parts.q: We don't have ______ bread for breakfast. Please buy some.
parts.explain: Sanalmaydigan ot (bread) oldidan yetishmasligini bildiradi: enough bread.

parts.q: Who is ______ person in your family?
parts.explain: Oiladagilarni solishtirishda orttirma daraja kerak: the oldest.

parts.q: Nodir is ______ player in our basketball team.
parts.explain: Jamoa ichida solishtirilgani uchun orttirma daraja kerak: the tallest.

parts.q: The water in the swimming pool is warm ______ today.
parts.explain: Sifatdan keyin kelib yetarli darajada iliqligini bildiradi: warm enough.

wrong.too: Sifatdan oldin keladi va salbiy ma’no beradi.

parts.q: There is ______ salt in the soup; I cannot eat it.
parts.explain: Sanalmaydigan ot (salt) bilan ortiqchalikni bildiradi: too much salt.

parts.q: I don't have ______ patience to wait in this long queue.
parts.explain: Sanalmaydigan ot (patience) oldidan yetishmaslikni bildiradi: enough patience.

wrong.too much: Inkor gapda yetarli emasligini bildirish uchun «enough» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: She bought ______ apples to bake a big pie.
parts.explain: Sanaladigan ko‘plikdagi ot oldidan yetarlilikni bildiradi: enough apples.

parts.q: I have very little time. → I do not have ______
parts.explain: «Very little time» iborasi «enough» va ot birikmasi yordamida inkor shaklga o'giriladi.

parts.q: The soup is extremely salty. → The soup is ______
parts.explain: «Extremely salty» holati «too» yordamida sifat bilan ifodalanadi.

parts.q: There is a lot of sugar in my tea. → There is ______
parts.explain: «A lot of sugar» miqdori «too much» yordamida ko'rsatiladi.

parts.q: The bag is extremely heavy. → The bag is ______
parts.explain: «Extremely heavy» iborasi «too» so'zi yordamida beriladi.

parts.q: The box is very large. → The box is ______
parts.explain: «Very large» iborasi «too» so'zi yordamida ifodalanadi.

parts.q: There are many students in the room. → There are ______
parts.explain: Sanoqli otlar bilan «too many» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The music is very loud. → The music is ______
parts.explain: «Very loud» iborasi «too» so'zi bilan yoziladi.

parts.q: There is a lot of noise outside. → There is ______
parts.explain: Sanab bo'lmaydigan otlar bilan «too much» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: This test is very difficult. → This test is ______
parts.explain: «Very difficult» iborasi «too» so'zi bilan yoziladi.

parts.q: There is a lot of water on the floor. → There is ______
parts.explain: «Water» sanalmaydi, shuning uchun «too much» keladi.

parts.q: The room is very dark. → The room is not ______
parts.explain: Gapda «very dark» va 'not' bor, shuning uchun 'adjective + enough': bright enough.

parts.q: The tea is extremely hot. → The tea is ______
parts.explain: «too» so'zi sifatdan oldin kelib me'yordan ortiqligini bildiradi va oxirida «to» qo'shimchasi ishlatiladi.

parts.q: She is very young. → She is not ______
parts.explain: «enough» so'zi sifatdan keyin kelib yetarli darajani bildiradi. «Not» bilan «old enough» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The coat is very small. → The coat is ______
parts.explain: Hadddan tashqari kichikligini bildirish uchun «too» va sifat qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: We have many notebooks. → We have ______
parts.explain: «enough» otlardan oldin kelib yetarli miqdorni bildiradi («notebooks»).

parts.q: The jacket is extremely thin. → The jacket is ______
parts.explain: Salbiy ma'nodagi ortiqlikni ko'rsatish uchun sifatdan oldin «too» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: He is very short. → He is not ______
parts.answer: tall enough to reach the shelf
parts.explain: Yetarli bo'lmagan holatni bildirish uchun «not» va sifatdan keyin «enough» keladi.

parts.q: The shoes are very big. → The shoes are ______
parts.explain: Hajmi kattaligi me'yordan ortiqligini ko'rsatish uchun «too» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: I have much free time. → I have ______
parts.explain: «enough» otlardan oldin («free time») yetarli miqdorni bildirish uchun keladi.

parts.q: The backpack is extremely heavy. → The backpack is ______
parts.explain: Ishni bajarib bo'lmas darajada og'irligini ko'rsatish uchun «too» qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: She is very quiet. → She is not ______
parts.explain: Yetarli darajada emasligini ko'rsatish uchun sifatdan keyin «enough» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The film is very long. → The film is ______
parts.explain: Me'yordan uzunligini ko'rsatish uchun sifatdan oldin «too» qo'yiladi.

parts.q: We have many chairs. → We have ______
parts.explain: Otlardan oldin («chairs») yetarli ekanligini bildirish uchun «enough» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: The exercise is extremely difficult. → The exercise is ______
parts.explain: Qiyinligi me'yordan oshib ketganini bildirish uchun «too» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: He is very slow. → He is not ______
parts.answer: fast enough to win the race
parts.explain: Yetarli darajada tez emasligini ko'rsatish uchun sifatdan keyin «enough» keladi.

parts.q: The soup is extremely spicy. → The soup is ______
parts.explain: Achchiqligi ortiqcha ekanini bildirish uchun sifatdan oldin «too» ishlatiladi.

parts.q: I have much money. → I have ______
parts.answer: enough money to buy a ticket
parts.explain: «enough» oti oldidan kelib yetarli mablag' borligini ko'rsatadi.

parts.q: The coffee is extremely bitter. → The coffee is ______
parts.explain: Achchiqligi me'yordan ortiqligini ko'rsatish uchun «too» qo'llaniladi.

parts.q: She is very weak. → She is not ______
parts.answer: strong enough to lift the box
parts.explain: Yetarli darajada kuchli emasligini bildirish uchun «enough» sifatdan keyin keladi.

parts.q: The room is extremely cold. → The room is ______
parts.explain: Sovuqlik darajasi yuqoriligini bildirish uchun sifatdan oldin «too» ishlatiladi.

intro.what: Biz narsalar, odamlar va joylarni solishtirish uchun qiyosiy (comparative) va orttirma (superlative) darajadagi sifatlardan foydalanamiz. Shuningdek, 'too' va 'enough' so'zlari orqali me'yor ortiqchaligini yoki yetarliligini bildiramiz.
when: Bir guruh ichida eng yaxshisini ajratib ko'rsatganda
Biror narsa juda ko'p yoki keragidan ortiq ekanligini aytganda
Kerakli miqdor yoki daraja yetarli ekanligini bildirganimizda

structures.label: Superlative adjectives
structures.example_en: Samarkand is the most beautiful city in Uzbekistan.

structures.label: too + adjective
structures.example_en: This tea is too hot to drink.
structures.example_uz: Bu choy ichish uchun juda issiq.

structures.label: adjective + enough
structures.example_en: Aziz is tall enough to play basketball.
structures.example_uz: Aziz basketbol o'ynash uchun yetarlicha uzun bo'yli.

structures.label: enough + noun
structures.example_en: We have enough water for the trip.

rules.title: Qisqa sifatlar
rules.text: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga '-er' yoki '-est' qo'shimchasi qo'shiladi.

examples.en: My bag is heavier than yours.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain.

rules.title: Uzun sifatlar
rules.text: Ikki yoki undan ortiq bo'g'inli sifatlar oldidan 'more' yoki 'the most' ishlatiladi.

examples.en: English is more interesting than physics.
This is the most difficult test.

rules.title: Too va Enough
rules.text: 'Too' sifatdan oldin kelib salbiy ma'no beradi, 'enough' esa sifatdan keyin yoki otning oldidan kelib yetarlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: The shoes are too small for my feet.
examples.uz: Oyoq kiyim oyog'im uchun juda kichik.

examples.en: I have enough money to buy a notebook.

mistakes.wrong: My brother is more tall than me.
mistakes.right: My brother is taller than me.
mistakes.why: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga 'more' qo'shilmaydi, oxiriga '-er' qo'shiladi.

mistakes.right: This is the most easy lesson.
mistakes.why: Orttirma darajadagi sifatlardan oldin albatta 'the' aniqlik artikli ishlatilishi shart.
'Too' so'zi sifatdan keyin emas, balki oldin kelishi kerak.
'Enough' so'zi otdan oldin keladi, otdan keyin kelmaydi.
